## Key Industrial Divisions & Product Catalogue
1. **Power Tools & Machinery:** Drill machines, cut-off machines, angle grinder machines, tiles cutters, hammer machines, breaker machines, welding machines.
2. **Hand Tools:** Hammers, chisels, hoe/manvetti, crowbars, screwdrivers, line testers, crimping tools, bolt cutters, tin cutters, wire strippers, cutting pliers, nose pliers, side cutters, water pump pliers, adjustable wrenches, pipe wrenches, circlip pliers, socket wrenches, spanners, allen keys, D-shackles, crane belts, loading belts, vernier calipers, bench vices, hydraulic bottle jacks.
3. **Pipes, Tubes, Fittings & Gate Accessories:** Gate designing fittings, sheet metals, hinges, tower bolts, aldrops, level tubes, MS plates.
4. **Hardwares & Fasteners:** MS nails, MS bolt nuts, screws, anchor bolts, foundation bolts, concrete nails.
5. **Electricals & Regulators:** Line testers, crimping tools, oxygen/LPG/acetylene regulators, flash back arrestors.
6. **Safety Equipment (PPE):** Safety shoes, safety helmets, safety jerkins, safety belts, safety gloves, safety masks, gumboots, reflective road studs, PPE kits, fire extinguishers, safety goggles, cones, barrication tapes.
7. **Adhesives, Sealants & Waterproofing:** Silicon, Fevicol, Araldite, Anabond, PU foams, Dr. Fixit, Fosroc, Sika, double-sided tapes, shuttering tapes, masking tapes, leakage arresting tapes.
8. **Abrasives & Cutting Tools:** Cutting wheels, grinding wheels, polishing wheels, emery paper, flap discs, CD papers.
9. **Welding Equipment & Electrodes:** Gas cutting torches, hoses, nozzles, MS welding electrodes, brass electrodes.
10. **Construction Materials & Netting:** Concrete paper rolls, love birds netting, shade nets, masonry trowels/karni, matta palagai, MS/plastic satti, wheelbarrows, fiber mesh, spirit levels, cover blocks, MS wire, GI wire, expansion joint pads, manhole covers.
11. **Paints, Primers & Rust Removers:** Red oxide, yellow primer, grey primer, spray paint, paint brushes, paint rollers, WD-40, G1 rust remover, Termiguard liquid & spray.
12. **Locks & Security:** Beehive/Beerow locks, gate locks, shutter locks, Venus padlocks 67mm.
